selected_rule.selection_rule: maximum Existing69 coverage subject to >=0.95 candidate precision among nine predefined invariance-by-distance rules

evidence_boundary.numeric_and_oracle_outputs: pre-existing complete three-model Test131 interface records

classification.3/4 invariant: three of four choose the same candidate, with one missing or one dissent
classification.4/4 invariant: all four component-valid hypotheses choose the same candidate
classification.checkerboard/interaction: DD=GG and DG=GD with the two diagonals disagreeing
classification.invalid/component-insufficient: fewer than three usable hypotheses or an incomplete disagreeing pattern
classification.lattice-source sensitive: DD=GD and DG=GG with the two lattice-source columns disagreeing
classification.target-source sensitive: DD=DG and GD=GG with the two target-source rows disagreeing
